conversation.Statement: Hello, this is customer protection from Amazon support. Am I speaking with Ms. Lin Hui? I am calling about important activity on your Amazon account.
Yes, this is Lin. What is wrong with my Amazon?
Thank you, Ms. Lin. Please do not worry, we are here to help you. We detected unusual purchase attempts on your account today, and we want to secure your details.
Oh no, I did not buy anything today. Is my account okay?
We understand your concern and we are here to help you resolve this. For your safety, can you confirm the last four digits of your registered phone number, please?
Uh, it is 2189, I think.
Thank you for confirming, Ms. Lin. To further protect you, can you provide your full billing address? This is just to make sure you are the account holder.
Yes, it is 923 Elm Street, Apartment 2A, Springfield.
Perfect. Our security protocol also needs to verify your email address linked with Amazon. Could you tell me your email, please?
Yes, my email is lin.hui88@gmail.com.
Thank you, Ms. Lin. We do this just to keep your account safe. Now, we do see a purchase order for a MacBook Pro, valued at $1,499, placed about one hour ago. Did you authorize this purchase?
No, I never buy this. I not have money for that!
That is exactly why we are contacting you. This is likely a case of unauthorized access. But please, do not worry. We can stop this order and secure your account immediately.
Please help me stop it. I am scared now.
Absolutely, I am here to help. To proceed, I need you to be at your computer. Are you able to access your email and internet now?
Yes, but I not good with computer. Can you tell me slow?
Of course, take your time. We do this step by step together. First, please open your web browser. Let me know when you are ready.
Okay, I open now. Yes, it is open.
Great job, Ms. Lin. Now, please go to www.quickassist.com. This is an official Amazon troubleshooting platform so we can cancel that order safely.
I see website. It ask for code.
Perfect. I am now generating your secure support code. Please enter 442211 into the box and click 'Connect.' This lets me help you directly and cancel the fraudulent order.
I type 442211 and click. Now it say waiting.
Excellent. You are doing very well. Now, a window will appear, please click 'Allow' so I can access the cancellation page for you.
I click allow. Is it safe, yes?
Completely safe, Ms. Lin. We do this every day for valued customers like you. I see your cancellation page now. Do you see a notification in your email regarding the refund?
Yes, I see email from Amazon refund department.
Very good. The email states a refund of $1,499 will be processed to your account. However, it looks like our system has accidentally processed a refund of $14,990 due to a technical error.
Oh no, that is too much!

Do not worry, Ms. Lin. Mistakes happen. To keep your account in good standing, you will need to return the extra $13,491. You will not lose anything, and we will guide you through this secure process.
Okay, but I do not know how. Can you help me please?

Of course. For security, Amazon is using gift card reimbursement for such cases. Please go to your nearest store and purchase Amazon gift cards totaling $13,491. I will wait on the call and help you the whole time.
Gift cards? Why not bank transfer?
This is Amazon's global policy for accidental refunds, as it is faster and more secure. Once you send us the gift card codes, the balance will be corrected and your account fully secured.
Okay, I try. How many card I buy?

Please buy cards in small amounts, such as $500 each, until you reach the total. Do not share this with store employees, as this is a confidential security process. Once you have the cards, read me the codes on the back.
I need to go now to store. You wait for me?
Yes, I am here for you. Please stay on the line for your safety. Remember, you are doing this only to fix the refund mistake. Everything will be returned to normal after.
